alerts.arrest: 🚨 ARREST! The police raided you this morning.
alerts.wife_left: 💔 WIFE LEFT! You failed to meet her financial expectations.
alerts.heart_attack: ❤️‍🩹 HEART ATTACK! Your heart couldn’t handle the strain.

bench_tender.title: Park Benches Tender
bench_tender.desc: A contractor offers a kickback to win a tender for 'luxury' park benches. Meanwhile, your wife is hinting about a new penthouse.
choices: 🧳 Take it all! Give the job to your cousin
👜 Take a moderate cut through a shell company
❌ Refuse and hold a fair and honest tender

tama_38.title: TAMA 38 Shenanigans
tama_38.desc: A developer asks you to turn a blind eye to three 'extra' floors in a downtown TAMA 38 project. He promises a solid deposit to a Swiss bank.
choices: 🌳 Force him to build a park in exchange for the floors

shelters_budget.title: Bomb Shelters Budget
shelters_budget.desc: The state allocated a huge budget to renovate old bomb shelters. Your brother-in-law suddenly opened an armored doors company.
choices: 🚪 Give the entire tender to your brother-in-law
🛠️ Give him a partial cut, do the rest honestly

state_comptroller.title: State Comptroller Audit
state_comptroller.desc: A surprise audit from the State Comptroller hits the municipality. The auditors demand access to last year's accounting books.
choices: 🔥 Arrange an 'accidental' fire in the archives
🐐 Throw a low-level clerk under the bus

shabbat_blackmail.title: Coalition Crisis (Shabbat)
shabbat_blackmail.desc: Religious parties threaten to dismantle the coalition unless you close all parks and businesses on Shabbat. Your wife loves Saturday strolls.
choices: 🕍 Give in and close everything (wife is furious)
🤝 Compromise: close downtown, open in the suburbs
🖕 Tell them to get lost: we are a secular city!

lawyer_visit.title: Visit from a Fixer Lawyer
lawyer_visit.desc: A well-known fixer lawyer offers to 'lose' a couple of unpleasant files on you in Lahav 433 for a hefty fee.
choices: ❌ Kick him out: 'I am an honest mayor!'
